column1: # The slowest recorded value of each guest wait, by host class.
# Evidence of decision 9's rule (docs/design/runtime-architecture.md), cited there: no wait is seeded from a row
# (2026-11-13), but for the guest's first boot to ready, whose bound is still its class's boot_ready row, or with none
# the slowest of any class's, until a first boot that follows the guest's liveness replaces it (owed). Every other
# wait follows its party until its first answer and is bounded by the slowest answer its node has seen.
# Read at build time by hex_client::guest::shards (include_str!) for that one bound, re-exported by hex_runtime::guest.
# Windows-WHP rows: shards.exe a debug build, AWS-LC without assembly (AWS_LC_SYS_NO_ASM), as its records say.
